title: Chicken, Mushroom & Bacon Pies
description: Golden, flaky, and stuffed with comfort — a proper home-baked classic where pub fare meets homemade love.

method.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 5-6 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add bacon and cook for 3-4 minutes until crispy. Add green onions, garlic, and mushrooms. Cook for another 3-4 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Sprinkle flour over the mixture and stir for 1 minute to cook out the raw flour taste.
Gradually add the chicken stock, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until thickened.
Return chicken to the pan along with the cooking cream. Stir well, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely.
Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan-forced). Grease 6 individual pie tins (approximately 10cm diameter).
Cut circles from the shortcrust pastry to fit the base and sides of each tin. Press in gently and trim excess.
Divide the cooled chicken filling evenly among the pastry-lined tins.

Cut circles from the puff pastry slightly larger than the pie tins. Place on top of each pie, press edges to seal, and trim excess. Cut a small slit in the center of each pie to allow steam to escape.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 30-35 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Allow pies to rest for 5 minutes before serving. Serve hot with a side salad or steamed vegetables.

notes.title: Make Ahead
notes.content: These pies can be assembled (unbaked) and frozen for up to 2 months. Bake from frozen, adding 10-15 minutes to the cooking time.

notes.title: Scaling Up
notes.content: This recipe can be doubled for café-style servings or larger gatherings. Baking times remain roughly the same, but keep an eye on the pies for golden perfection.
